capabilities: Groups tasks into configurable sector tags on a board
Captures tasks through quick capture, brain dump and selected lines
Guides daily, weekly and monthly reviews sector by sector
Plans appointments and milestones in a year plan
Shows online calendar events and time blocks for today
extras: Manifest description still says the Tasks plugin is required, while the README says it is no longer needed. Only the optional calendars module uses the network; calendar addresses are stored in the plugin's data.json inside the vault. The README states all code is AI-generated (Claude) and advises reviewing it before use.
intentEvidence: The Tasks plugin is no longer needed since 1.5.0 (you can keep it installed; the file format is the same).
motivation: Many task plugins manage their own data format; the author wanted tasks to stay plain, readable lines in a single Markdown file that works as a source of truth with or without the plugin.
problem: Task managers that store tasks in their own data format leave a list you cannot read, edit or search like a normal note.

relations.evidence: The Tasks plugin is no longer needed since 1.5.0 (you can keep it installed; the file format is the same).
for Google Calendar: the calendar's settings → Secret address in iCal format

summary: Task board and year planner that keeps tasks as plain lines in one Markdown file, grouped by configurable time-sector tags.
